name: Reactive Prone Start, 10 m Sprint
setup: Lie face-down behind the line, hands under the chest.
cues: Go on a point or a call from a partner, not on your own count.
Pop up off the floor and drive the first steps low, pushing the floor back.
Lean and push the floor back behind you, like pushing a car.

faults.fault: Standing straight up out of the start
faults.fix: Stay low for the first three steps, pushing the floor back behind you.

faults.fault: Short, choppy first steps
faults.fix: Push the floor back long and hard on each of the first steps.

cautions: Full warm-up first; stop the set when the speed drops.
